title: Websites and apps: where they come from

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel ?born WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(STR(?bT), "|", STR(?bP)); separator=";") AS ?born) WHERE { { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q35127 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q620615 } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks ; wdt:P495 ?c . FILTER(?sitelinks > 30) ?item p:P571 ?st . ?st a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P571 [ wikibase:timeValue ?bT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?bP ] . } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?c)=1) ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 300 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 199

rows.label: Wikipedia
rows.description: free multilingual online encyclopedia
rows.hook: is a free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit

rows.label: Facebook
rows.description: American online social media and social networking service
rows.hook: is the giant social network where people share status updates and photos with friends

rows.label: Spotify
rows.description: Swedish audio streaming service
rows.hook: is a streaming service where listeners play millions of songs and podcasts

rows.label: Rotten Tomatoes
rows.description: American review aggregator for film and television
rows.hook: rates movies with a splat or fresh-tomato percentage score from critics

rows.label: Metacritic
rows.description: website that aggregates reviews of music albums, games, movies, TV shows, DVDs, and formerly, books
rows.hook: collects critics' reviews into a single weighted score for games, films and albums

rows.label: Wikiquote
rows.description: free multilingual online collection of quotes
rows.hook: is a free collection of famous sayings and what notable people said

rows.label: Proton Mail
rows.description: end-to-end encrypted e-mail service from Proton AG
rows.hook: is a privacy-focused email service that encrypts messages so only the sender and recipient can read them

rows.label: VLC media player
rows.description: media player, streaming client, streaming media server, and audio and video converter (transcoder), free/libre and open-source cross-platform software
rows.hook: is a free app with an orange traffic-cone icon that opens almost any video file

rows.label: Crunchyroll
rows.description: American video streaming service
rows.hook: is a streaming site that is a go-to home for anime

rows.label: Napster
rows.description: online music service
rows.hook: let people swap music files until lawsuits from the record industry shut it down

rows.label: Threads
rows.description: social networking site operated by Meta Platforms
rows.hook: is a text-based social app launched as a rival to Twitter by the owner of Facebook

rows.label: Wiktionary
rows.description: free online multilingual dictionary
rows.hook: is a free online dictionary written by volunteers

rows.label: WeChat
rows.description: messaging, social media, and payment app developed by Tencent
rows.hook: is the all-in-one app used for chatting, social posts and paying at shops

rows.label: OpenStreetMap
rows.description: online collaborative project creating a world geographic database
rows.hook: is a free, volunteer-made map of the world, often called the Wikipedia of maps

rows.label: VK
rows.description: social networking service from Russia
rows.hook: is a social network often called the Facebook of its home region

rows.label: Flightradar24
rows.description: Swedish internet-based service that shows real-time aircraft flight tracking information on a map
rows.hook: is a site that lets anyone watch live planes moving across a world map

rows.label: Wikimedia Commons
rows.description: online repository of free-use image, audio, and other media files
rows.hook: is a free archive of photos, sounds and videos that supplies pictures for encyclopedia articles

rows.label: Tencent QQ
rows.description: instant messaging software service
rows.hook: is a hugely popular instant messenger with a little penguin as its logo

rows.label: YouTube Premium
rows.description: paid streaming subscription service
rows.hook: is a paid upgrade that removes ads from videos and adds background playback

rows.label: Wikisource
rows.description: online multilingual library that collects open-content source material
rows.hook: is a free digital library of books, speeches and historical documents

rows.label: arXiv
rows.description: online digital archive for electronic preprints of scientific papers
rows.hook: is the free site where scientists post research papers before they are peer reviewed

rows.label: xkcd
rows.description: webcomic created by Randall Munroe
rows.hook: is a webcomic of stick figures covering science, math and geek humor
